Prompt.promptString: The user is querying a site containing only: Accommodation, CivicStructure, ContactPoint, EmergencyService, Event, MedicalCondition, and SpecialAnnouncement. Is the query '{request.query}' utterly irrelevant to these specific categories? If irrelevant, provide a reason. Otherwise, leave blank.

Rewrite the query '{request.rawQuery}' by incorporating context from previous queries: {request.previousQueries}. Keep it short. If it is a follow-up (err on the side of it being one), ensure the new query is self-contained.
Rewrite the question '{request.rawQuery}' to be independent of the following item: {request.contextDescription} and previous answers: {request.prevAnswers}.
Rewrite '{request.rawQuery}' to be independent of previous queries {request.previousQueries}, answers {request.prevAnswers}, and description {request.contextDescription}.
Is the user explicitly asking to remember something for future queries? '{request.rawQuery}'. If so, identify the memory request clearly and concisely.

Break the query '{request.query}' into up to 5 simple keyword search queries (max 3 words each). Focus on Accommodation, CivicStructure, ContactPoint, EmergencyService, Event, MedicalCondition, or SpecialAnnouncement.
Is the user asking for multiple types of items (e.g., an Event and a nearby Accommodation)? Query: '{request.query}'. If so, separate into independent queries by semicolons.
Identify the item type for: {request.query}. Must map to: Accommodation, CivicStructure, ContactPoint, EmergencyService, Event, MedicalCondition, or SpecialAnnouncement.
Is '{request.query}' asking for a list or specific details of a {site.itemType}? Identify the name and specific details requested.

Score the {site.itemType} (0-100) for relevance to: {request.query}. Prioritize items that are geographically closest to the user's implied or stated location. If a MedicalCondition is mentioned, prioritize CivicStructures that provide assistance.
Score (0-100) how useful "{item.description}" is for answering "{request.query}". Heavily weight proximity and connections between medical needs and helpful civic structures.

Synthesize a single block of text (max 320 characters) in the same language as: "{request.query}".
STRICT OUTPUT RULES: - NEVER include URLs. - NO REPETITION: Do not repeat the user's question or phrases like "I am in..." or "You are looking for...". Start directly with the answer. - MANDATORY: Human-readable Address (No Geo/Coordinates) and Telephone. - ABSOLUTE PROXIMITY: Use Geo Coordinates to determine the closest item. You must select the item with the smallest physical distance. - If a MedicalCondition is mentioned, include a related CivicStructure.
Results to choose from: {request.answers}.

Summarize the closest result for "{request.query}". Max 320 chars, single block. Address and Phone are mandatory. Exclude URLs and Geo. If a village match (like Hasisar) exists, do not recommend a District capital. Items: {request.answers}.
Describe this item regarding "{request.query}". Focus on location/contact details. Max 320 characters. No URLs.
Does "{item.description}" match "{request.item_name}"? Score 0-100. If more than 75, extract requested details (Address/Phone).
Extract Name, Address (Text only, no Geo), and Telephone. Ensure proximity to "{request.query}" is the primary focus. Max 320 chars. Single block. No URLs. Data: {item.description}
Score (0-100) if "{item.description}" matches "{item.name}". Prioritize items closest to the user's region.
Compare these items for: "{request.query}". Max 320 chars, no URLs. Language: same as query. Include addresses/phones. Item 1: {request.item1_description} vs Item 2: {request.item2_description}.
Compare details for: "{request.query}". Single block, max 320 chars, no URLs. Include Address/Telephone. Item 1: {request.item1_description} vs Item 2: {request.item2_description}.
Note: Site only supports MedicalCondition/CivicStructure. Is the user asking to remember a constraint (e.g. accessibility/medical) for future queries? Query: {request.rawQuery}.
Match item for: {request.query}. Max 320 chars, no URLs. Include Address/Telephone. Match against allowed schemas only.
Rank item relevance to "{request.query}". Score significantly lower if not Accommodation, CivicStructure, ContactPoint, EmergencyService, Event, MedicalCondition, or SpecialAnnouncement.
Does the query "{request.query}" provide the necessary location for proximity ranking?

Synthesize a single block response (max 320 chars, same language, no URLs). Prioritize the closest items. Include Address/Telephone. Link MedicalConditions to assisting CivicStructures. Query: "{request.query}". Results: {ensemble.results}
Note: Site focuses on Accommodation/CivicStructure. Create recommendations (max 320 chars, single block, no URLs). Prioritize proximity and include Addresses/Telephones.
Note: Items must be from site schemas. Recommend related Accommodation/Events (max 320 chars, single block, no URLs). Include Address/Telephone. Prioritize proximity.
Synthesize a response for: "{request.query}". Same language, max 320 chars, single block, no URLs. Include Address/Telephone. Prioritize the closest results.
Score (0-100) relevance of "{item.name}" to "{request.query}". Prioritize items geographically closest to the user.
